FN-J6IXFYF-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 313
Committee: Banking & Insurance Sponsor: Senator Bobby Singleton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/10/2024
REVISED
Senate Bill 313 as introduced could increase the obligations of the Public Education Employees'
Health Insurance Board by an estimated $4.5 million and the obligations of the Alabama State
Employees Insurance Board by an estimated $3.6 million due to the minimum rate set for health
insurers to pay out-of-network ground ambulance providers in this bill.
